title: Folding lamp, aside that repeats the line
challenge: After the kept reading, the speaker repeats the line to themselves as a question.
script: This lamp folds flat into your bag.
It lasts all week on one charge.
It costs less than a pizza.

units.say: This lamp folds flat into your bag.
It lasts all week on one charge.
It lasts all week on one charge? Yeah.
It costs less than a pizza.
